quest.title: Mushounin
quest.description: After listening to the legend of Seishimaru, Xavier seems to have a new idea...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: "And well, if I can get my fill of food, then sure! I'll follow Seishimaru." Haha, the character I'm playing this time is pretty cute.

talks.objective: Look for the two performers and talk to them

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: You're the one who was involved in the screening, you're...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm so sorry, I didn't remember your name.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: It's my fault for having a faulty memory. Sorry I gave you guys a hard time when we were filming.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: I know Xavier is from Fontaine. My most important person is also an outlander, so I understand how difficult it is to be alone in a foreign land.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: I was picky in the past and caused him trouble. Looking back on it pricks at my conscience.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We still need actors.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: Is this what Mr. Xavier wants? Th-Then please allow me to participate.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: I was called in to participate in the shooting before, though I was only paid the price of a meal. But money that's paid is paid, so I will finish what I started.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Komore Teahouse</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: Got it. I'll go tell my family later that I'm going to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Komore Teahouse</color>.

talks.objective: Look for the two performers and talk to them

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: #You've come, {NICKNAME}? I know it is rude to say this, but...

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: I'm sorry! May I ask if Mr. Xavier still needs an actress?

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: I left in a rage, and failed Master in her painstaking efforts of expressing concern as well as messing up the quest given by the head of the family. I have disgraced the Yashiro Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Master has reprimanded me, so please, I beseech you, please mention this to Xavier so I may do my duty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did Furuta say to you?

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: No, no, Master only asked me to think about why I want to stay with the Yashiro Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: I made a vow to the head of the family and to the Kamisato Clan that I would never do anything detrimental to the name of the Kamisato Clan in a fit of pique.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: I was too reckless, and indolent, and as a Shuu... no, as a servant of the Kamisato Clan, I was very much out of line.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: And Mr. Xavier was actually very kind to me. Once again, I... I'm so sorry!

choices.text: You don't have to be so anxious.

response.speaker: Koharu
response.text: You mean I still have a chance, and I can go and apologize to Mr. Xavier to make up for my mistake?

response.speaker: Koharu
response.text: Wonderful, wonderful! I must do well this time. Your generosity is appreciated.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Komore Teahouse</color>.

response.speaker: Koharu
response.text: I'll set out right away after I've tidied up my appearance.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Perfect, this is the story I had in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Mr. Sasano, and Miss Koharu, the performances you've contributed touched my heart! Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: Hehe, surely you're exaggerating.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Yay!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: It's true, you two. This story has a perfect ending to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I've been hoping to film a perfect swashbuckler film, and now I finally realized this dream.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Now I can hold my chest up high and hand this film over to the Yashiro Commissioner.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: I feel very lucky to be part of this story too.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, this story is really familiar. I keep feeling like I've heard it before.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Have you heard about the legend of Seishimaru? I heard about it only a while ago from the owner of Uyuu Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Mr. Okazaki? In the story I heard, Seishimaru had the surname Kawasaki, or was it Shimazaki? I can't really remember.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: It's okay, folklores usually have many versions, and the same can be said about legends of Fontaine and Sumeru, too.

choices.text: What kind of legend does Sumeru have?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: True, true. If Sumeru or Fontaine or even Natlan local legends were used as the source material, what sort of story would we have? Ah, I would certainly love to make some films there too.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: *cough* But before that, I should try to find an opportunity to return to Fontaine. I've heard that some of my colleagues have also come up with machines with functions similar to the Film Kamera.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: They have even given those machines all manner of names, such as the "Moving Picture Device" or the "Motion Picture Machine"... and they're currently arguing over who should get the patent to boot.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well, I shan't bother with this... pointless quibbling. My one priority is to continue refining my Film Kamera.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well then, I shall see you later, Traveler. Should we meet again, perhaps you'd like to help me shoot a film once more...?

choices.text: What kind of legend does Fontaine have?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Mr. Sasano, you have much longer lines in this scene, so you must memorize them well and not make any mistakes.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Is it too difficult for you?

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: I thought I would end up struggling with the previous script, but I was surprised to find out that Xavier had written a new one in just one day.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: How can I do anything but my best after that? Don't worry, I've memorized my lines carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: I'm very confident in this script, and I'll do my best to act it well.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Okay, Miss Koharu, about the script... Do you have anything that you need me to explain?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: This scene requires a very emotional performance from you. I hope you can portray a playful girl who sells tea.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: I've rehearsed the lines many times on my own after I received the script, so I'm sure I can perform better than before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we're late. Everyone's already rehearsing.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Phew... Good, now the main actors are all here.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: #I've brought the new script as we agreed yesterday, {NICKNAME}. Do you want to read it?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: The story is based on the legend of Seishimaru. Other than the Seishimaru and Wakayama characters, I've added a new original character called Yano Machiko.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks it flows much better than before!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Many details can be embellished, given more time, but it's already a challenge to shoot all of this with my current ability.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Okay, enough chitchat. We have to bring out our professionalism.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Mr. Sasano and Miss Koharu from the supporting cast are ready. As for the set, I've decided to shoot the first scene in the Komore Teahouse.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: So, Mr. Thoma has asked the owner of the teahouse for a favor and fortunately, we can borrow a private room there.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Now we're just waiting for the main character, and that's you. We can start the shooting any time when you're ready.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: You can read the script first. There's no need to be nervous. I've marked all the important lines, so take your time.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: If you make a mistake in a line, we can re-shoot it to get the most desirable effect.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still need more time to read the script.

talks.objective: Talk to Xavier to begin the shoot

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Yamada Hifumi
dialogues.text: Just my luck to have run into a tough nut!

dialogues.speaker: Yamamoto
dialogues.text: Ah, so unlucky.

dialogues.speaker: Tanaka
dialogues.text: No, my lord, Master, we aren't saying anything bad about you, I swear!

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: "It's been a while, Seishimaru." Yeah, Xavier said that it's best to be as calm as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Everyone did a good job. The effect was perfect this time.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Mr. Sasano's performance was full of power and conveyed the charisma of his character, Wakayama Keisuke.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Um, Mr. Xavier... There's something I'm curious about. Can I ask you about it?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Of course. Ah, I must say, Machiko was very lively and playful earlier, just as I'd envisioned.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Wakayama Keisuke chose to let Seishimaru take revenge on him, and that's actually to make Seishimaru cool his temper, right?

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: It was out of the goodness of his heart, so would it be better if this character sounded gentler? The current lines feel a little... cruel.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I, too, considered making Keisuke a gentleman, but eventually I gave him this cold and stiff style.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: But you're right... This story should have another possibility.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hm... Should I make more adjustments?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xavier is doing well now.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Mr. Xavier, there is no need to doubt yourself. The reason I asked is that I don't understand why the script was written that way.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: I can sense that you are very talented in writing. Please continue what you were planning on doing.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Thank you for saying that, Miss Koharu. Then let's carry on.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: For the next scene, I'd like to go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Nazuchi Beach</color>. Given the lighting of location, it should be shot in the <color=#00E1FFFF>evening</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Let's all get ready and start shooting the next scene in the <color=#00E1FFFF>evening</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Yamada Hifumi
dialogues.text: This thing about "shadows" has nothing to do with us. Make payments and we're done.

dialogues.speaker: Tanaka
dialogues.text: Just pay money and you can shoot "shadows" in this area, heheh.

dialogues.speaker: Yamamoto
dialogues.text: Tanaka, you can't say that. Whether you can shoot the shadows well after paying depends entirely on Hifumi's mood.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Friends, I've applied in advance to the Yashiro Commission. The filming is in full compliance with the Inazuman regulations.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: If you are willing, you can participate too. We happen to need a few more actors for the next scene.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: To be involved in the process of creating art is much more fun than money.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: Money is the only thing on their minds. Saying this stuff to them is useless... *sigh* Just when the shooting was finally going well... Why did we have to run into these guys?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's starting to feel sorry for them.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Poor Mr. Xavier for running into unreasonable people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon is saying that she feels sorry for these bad guys.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Yamada Hifumi
response.text: What are you talking about, you brat? Looking for a fight?

choices.text: Help us shoot the film, PLEASE.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: This is not the first time I've seen you fight. But I still have to say that you're terrifying.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Good thing we're friends. A hundred Xaviers wouldn't be a match for you...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I'm relieved then. The following scene requires you to channel the vigor of your fighting self.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: There aren't many lines for you in this scene, but you can still take a look at it.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: We will begin when you're ready.

choices.text: I will make no moves against you.

talks.objective: Talk to Xavier to begin the shoot

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Good. You all said your lines naturally and didn't make any mistakes.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Wait, they left already?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I added more lines for them. And even used their real names for the characters after obtaining their permission...

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: #Ignore those bullies. If it hadn't been for {NICKNAME}, this scene wouldn't have been shot.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're too modest.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: You delivered a smooth performance in that scene. Keep up this level and the next big scene will be no problem at all.

response.speaker: Koharu
response.text: Oh yes, there is one more scene next.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Yes, I thought about it yesterday when I wrote the script, and this last scene must be shot in a place with a cliff. The <color=#00E1FFFF>small island</color> to the east of <color=#00E1FFFF>Narukami Island</color> is very suitable.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well, this next scene on location is the key to the whole script, and I want to use the <color=#00E1FFFF>glow of sunset</color> as the backdrop.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: All of us have been shooting continuously for a long time, so we should take this time to rest. Let's meet <color=#00E1FFFF>tomorrow evening</color> at the designated location.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: The third act requires a little more from Mr. Sasano. This new character, Wakayama Kojuurou, is Wakayama Keisuke's younger brother and it is more appropriate to have Mr. Sasano play him.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: #You told me before, and I am mentally prepared. It's just... remember to pull your punches for that second fight scene, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: #Oh yes, the script! I forgot to hand the script to {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Look at me, all I'm thinking about is how to shoot the next scene and I forgot to give you the script. I am so sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: With past experiences from the first scenes, I believe you are already familiar with the way we shoot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? {M#He}{F#She} has to jump off a cliff at the end? That's really dangerous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you're used to jumping off high places and stuff, but now that you're doing it before a Film Kamera, you need to act more realistically.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And if that gets you into an accident, Paimon guesses it wouldn't be worth it, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knows you're used to facing all sorts of danger but you cannot think of yourself as an invincible person made of steel.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: #Dear Miss Paimon, we do not need {NICKNAME} to jump off a cliff here. {M#He}{F#She} just needs to glide down the cliff using a wind glider.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, if you say so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then go for it!

response.speaker: Koharu
response.text: Go!

response.speaker: Sasano
response.text: Go!

talks.objective: Talk to Xavier to begin the shoot

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still need more time to read the script.

dialogues.speaker: Yano Machiko
dialogues.text: Master Seishimaru, I've found you someone from the Wakayama Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Yano Machiko
dialogues.text: But Master Keisuke is already... gone. Please, let this all go.

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
dialogues.text: Hmph. So, Kurotani, you must have come for revenge on my brother.

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
dialogues.text: Now listen here. Keisuke worked himself to the bone day and night to settle the clan's affairs this entire year...

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
dialogues.text: And it was all because of your stupid agreement.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: You're a coward for placing sole blame on your father's executioner!

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: And you won't get your revenge now, no matter how much you want it.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: You know why? That's because our father's already gone.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: Kurotani, you didn't have what it took to avenge your adoptive parents!

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: And you wound up hurting Keisuke, who tried to persuade you with good intentions. You don't deserve to be called a samurai.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: Keisuke once said that executioners must be prepared to suffer retaliation.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: If you can't even stomach that, then you can forget about charging into battle and taking the lives of others.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: Since Keisuke isn't here anymore.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: Then I, his younger brother, Wakayama Kojuurou, am willing to take his place.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: It's too late for you to flee now. My brother died because of you, and I'll never forgive you.

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: Or let you go!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: #No, no, {NICKNAME}. This is not how it goes in the script.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I think you still need another look at the script and have a closer read of the ones I marked. We can start over when you are ready.

choices.text: Did he go see the doctor?

talks.objective: Land safely in the designated location

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
dialogues.text: As long as you don't kill me, I'll devote my life to seeking revenge, and I won't rest until one of us is dead.

choices.text: I said the same thing once before.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Well, it's fortunate that no one died. Just give it a rest, both of you!

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Look at this fuss you're both making...

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Clan this, revenge that — what about these vague notions is worth all this trouble anyway?

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: I just sell tea. As long as I can eat my fill, I'm happy.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: I couldn't care less what my last name is!

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: I don't have much of a way with words...

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: But rain falls into the lake, the lake water evaporates, and rain falls from the sky again.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Even if that rain water freezes, it will become sweet tea if you heat it over a stove.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Who cares whether the tea you were served came from the sky, the lake...

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: ...or the pot?

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Um... This might sound like sophistry.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: But I'm telling you both to stop this fighting now so you can go home to eat.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Huh? Why would you say that at a time like this? You're embarrassing me...

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Good grief... Well, I'll just assume you won't fight with Master Wakayama anymore, then.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: Turn back, he can't move right now anyway.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: Since my life is like rain and my death is like tea.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: Both are like water. There is no point clinging on to things like this.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: It's good that you think so!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If rains from the heavens can save the earth from calamity, then surely I can too, right?

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: My Lord!

response.speaker: Wakayama Kojuurou
response.text: Kurotani!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: #No, no, {NICKNAME}. This is not how it goes in the script.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I think you still need another look at the script and have a closer read of the ones I marked. We can start over when you are ready.

choices.text: You know you can't beat me.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Tell me when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
dialogues.text: It's been a while, Seishimaru.

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
dialogues.text: I've heard that you're in charge of the Kurotani Clan's affairs now.

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
dialogues.text: Looks like the dust has settled since that incident.

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
dialogues.text: Lord and Lady Kurotani are gone...

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
dialogues.text: #But you're taking up the mantle as their eldest {M#son}{F#daughter} to continue to serve the public.

dialogues.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
dialogues.text: I'm sure they would be pleased.

choices.text: Can the dust settle before vengeance is had?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: You? You want to take revenge?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: We are not children anymore!

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: How can you still be just as impulsive as you were back then?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: *sigh* With Lord Kurotani's abilities, the investigation never should have gone as wrong as it did.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: But he said himself that he was willing to accept the blame and punishment.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: The punishment from the great lords was indeed harsh...

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: But Lord Kurotani asked for it himself. I fear that there is still much left unsaid here.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Kurotani and Wakayama are both reputable clans.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: You now carry the clan name. You're a samurai in service of the public.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Not some wandering Nobushi ronin.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: So no matter how angry you are, you must be patient right now. You mustn't seek revenge.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: What's suspicious is some of the great lords' men!

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: They've been mighty pleased with themselves since my father's death.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: That's your anger clouding your judgment. They didn't necessarily have anything to do with it. Calm down!

choices.text: Whoever's eavesdropping outside, come on in.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Who are you? Who sent you to listen in on our conversation?

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: M—My apologies, good samurai, I—I'm just a tea seller, and my name is Machiko.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: It wasn't my intention to eavesdrop.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: #Seishimaru saved my life yesterday, and {M#he}{F#she} didn't ask for rice or money.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: #I just wanted to repay {M#him}{F#her} and then go back to selling my tea. I didn't mean any offense, honest!

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: You... Forget it, it's to be expected that a mere tea vendor wouldn't know proper etiquette.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: #Still, address {M#him}{F#her} as "Master Kurotani" from now on.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: You know what? This is quite opportune. The Kurotani Clan needs people, after all.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Why don't you stop selling tea and go with Master Kurotani?

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: #I don't wish to call {M#him}{F#her} Master Kurotani. Seishimaru has a better ring to it.

response.speaker: Yano Machiko
response.text: #Well, if I can get my fill of food, then sure! I'll follow {M#him}{F#her}.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Do whatever you like. Seishimaru, when Lord Kurotani is gone...

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: You're in charge of things now. Don't do anything foolish.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: If you let your temper get the better of you... *sigh*

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Anyway, what's important is that your family name continues.

choices.text: It wasn't your adoptive parents who died.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: ...Seriously? Has anything I've said made it through that thick skull of yours?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Let me ask you this:

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Will you really raise your blade against the great lords' men without a care for your clan?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Do you really wish to bring shame to your lord and disaster upon your family?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Oh, great. This is just great! So no one shall have peace until your rage dissipates, yes?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Well, since my efforts to persuade you otherwise have been ineffective, then let me give you the truth straight out.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Now, I've been the head of the Wakayama Clan since my father passed away.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: He served as Lord Kurotani's executioner.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: I know very well that he wronged your family and did great hurt to its name.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: And the execution was a matter of business, yes. But you're still my friend, and I still want to look after your family if at all possible...

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: So, if you still want revenge, I fear I must say that my father is already dead.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Well, come on then, punish me for his sins instead. I dare you.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Or are you hesitating because we are friends?

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Is that the extent of your resolve? Really? You can't even cut ties with me!

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: I was adopted anyway. The family name means nothing to me.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: Besides, is the good standing of the "Kurotani" name really more important than my parents' lives?

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: Well, I'll show you my resolve. Draw your weapon!

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: Put it and that Temari over there on the table.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: I'll close my eyes until you've placed them. Then, I'll extend a finger.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: If I point at your sword, then we must face each other in battle.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: If I point at the Temari, then we will sever all the bonds that lie between us.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: Let's leave this all to fate.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Hmph, so be it. We're all set.

response.speaker: Kurotani Seishimaru
response.text: It looks like our destiny has been decided. My life shall be devoted to vengeance. There shall be no rest till one of us is dead.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: Since you've made up your mind, then I must man up as well.

response.speaker: Wakayama Keisuke
response.text: I'll carry everything I said before through to the end. I'll be waiting for you.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: #No, no, {NICKNAME}. This is not how it goes in the script.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I think you still need another look at the script and have a closer read of the ones I marked. We can start over when you are ready.

choices.text: You don't have to try hard to learn your lines anyway.
You don't have to starve yourself to act anyway.
You, the one stealing food outside. Take me with you.
The lines are too long. I can't remember them.
I haven't eaten anything yet. I'm so hungry!
It's exhausting to film movies. I'm so tired.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: We will begin when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still need more time to read the script.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: So are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: The payment isn't actually that important to me. I applied for the job because I was interested in filming.

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: Xavier is a man of ideas, but that script was a little weird...

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: Please rest assured that I will treat film acting as an important form of training, and I am ready to risk my life for it.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: I've memorized the lines, and while I'm not very good at doing the "emotions" Mr. Xavier talked about, I will do my best to learn!

dialogues.speaker: Sasano
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm not much of a fighter. Remember to pull your punches for the fight scene.

dialogues.speaker: Koharu
dialogues.text: The next scene is a bit dangerous. Do be careful.
